simple.summary: מְטָא (mᵉṭâʼ) means to arrive , extend or happen First listed occurrence: Dan 4 8.

definitions.full: H4291. meta or metah מְטָה מְטָא, verb reach, attain (Targam id. , Syriac , compare Christian-Palestinian Aramaic Schulth Lex. 108 ; Ethiopic Arabic (for ) Nö ZMG xl (1886), 736 ; distinct from Biblical Hebrew מָצָא , etc., q. v.); — Pe`al Perfect 3masculine singular מְטָא Dan 4:25 , ָ ה 7:13 , 22 ; 3 feminine singular מְטַת 4:19 , מְטָת 4:21 Qr (Kt, erroneous, מטית K § 47, Beisp. 1 ) a )); 3 masculine plural מְטוֺ 6:25 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular יִמְטֵא 4:8 ; 4:17 ; — 1. a. reach, come to Dan 6:25 ( ל location); come unto, as far as 7:13 ( עַד person); absolute arrive 7:22 (of time; ᵐ5 ἐδόθη ; see Nes MM 41 who compare Arabic IV. give ). b. reach, extend , ל location Dan 4:8 ; 4:17 ; 4:19 . 2 with עַל person come upon, befall Dan 4:21 ; 4:25 .
definitions.rootNote: (Aramaic) or מְטָה ; (Aramaic), apparently corresponding to 4672 in the intransitive sense of being found present;
